heroHeadline: Trump Presses Zelensky to Cut Deal with Putin as US Diplomatic Pressure on Kyiv Intensifies
heroSubtitle: President Trump publicly urged Ukrainian President Zelensky to negotiate a deal with Putin to end the war, escalating US pressure on Kyiv following Zelensky's UN appeal and amid continued Russian drone and missile strikes. The move reinforces the Trump administration's push for a negotiated settlement and strains the US-Ukraine relationship at a pivotal moment. Separately, ArcelorMittal halted operations at Ukraine's largest steel plant in Kryvyi Rih after four Russian missile strikes in five weeks killed 5 workers and injured 17, booking a roughly $1 billion impairment charge and leaving all three of Ukraine's main steel plants offline.
